trailName: Elk Valley Forest Service Road / Koko Claims
notes: Infamous in Tour Divide folklore as the brutal 'Koko Claims' hike-a-bike. While the lower approach on Elk Valley FSR is rideable, the upper 2 miles deteriorate into a steep, washed-out boulder field of loose baby-head rocks with pitches exceeding 30%, forcing loaded riders into an arduous push. Prime grizzly bear corridor—keep bear spray readily accessible and make noise.
